title: Gallery of Droknar's weapons
wikitext:
[[Droknar]]'s weapons are the items obtained from the profession chests in [[Epilogue]], after completing [[A Time for Heroes]]. These items are all [[Perfect|perfect]]. If the profession uses only one type of weapon, like [[Dervish]] or [[Assassin]], they will have different names and different stats.

==Notes==
